name: warmachine-analyzer
description: Tooling-only root: git hooks (husky) that run lint --fix on staged files, plus dev scripts that start the docker compose infrastructure and both dev servers. Each package (backend, frontend) manages its own dependencies separately.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run generate
